reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web UI extension centered on managing skills and plugins, with additional file, terminal, Git, MCP, search, GitHub, vision, notification, and rescue-mode features.

summaries.zh: 这是一个为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供技能与插件管理，并集成文件树、终端、Git、MCP 和外部服务工具的扩展。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web UI extension for managing skills and plugins, with integrated file browsing, terminals, Git, MCP, and external-service tools.

capabilities: Installs, enables, disables, and uninstalls skills and plugins from npm, URLs, local paths, and Git repositories
Reads and edits files within a configured tree root
Creates and manages CMD or PowerShell terminal sessions and executes user-provided commands
Performs Git operations including fetch, push, staging, committing, and discarding changes
Connects to configured MCP servers and exposes their tools to the model
Calls Tavily, GitHub, and configurable OpenAI-compatible vision endpoints
